lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Roughly grid-aligned high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least five distinct horizontal rows spanning the mid-flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like matrix across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity transition with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of smaller high-luminance blobs is present on the visible surface and leading edge of the pectoral fin.
